chunks: And that the Prophet, peace be upon him and his family, only said:
"What lies between my grave and my pulpit is a garden from the gardens of Paradise."

key_terms.النَّبِيَّ: the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, the speaker of this reported statement
key_terms.الْجَنَّةِ: Paradise, the abode of divine reward
key_terms.رَوْضَةٌ: a garden, indicating a place of special blessing
key_terms.قَبْرِي: my grave, referring to the Prophet’s blessed grave
key_terms.مِنْبَرِي: my pulpit, referring to the Prophet’s pulpit in the mosque

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم say about the area between his grave and his pulpit?
ai.summary: This hadith attributes to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم a statement describing the area between his grave and his pulpit as a garden from the gardens of Paradise. It highlights the sanctity and spiritual distinction of this blessed place in al-Madinah.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: And the Prophet, peace be upon him and his family, said:
"What lies between my grave and my pulpit is a garden from the gardens of Paradise.".
